chapter: Sansu, Irma, Lee Dorsey and the Meters
title: Decline of New Orleans music in the 1960s
summary: Asked about the decline in national popularity, he says he does not know.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: In the 60s, New Orleans music declined in popularity as far as nationwide appeal. What do you think caused the inability of the independent record companies to function because of the high capital involved in putting out a record? Do you think it was heard by the invasion of English music?
In the middle 60s and late 60s. From your point of view, what happened then?
I don't know. Don't really know.
